name: Gaussian Splat Patch (Blender extension to clean and edit splat scans)
summary: Blender 5.3+ extension to erase, clone-stamp, heal, bridge and restore 3D Gaussian splat scans with brush tools, using Blender's native PLY/SPZ splat import. v0.2.0 adds Mesh to Splats: converts polygon meshes into splats via Cycles bakes (no training) so they can be merged with scans and exported as one PLY.

access.notes: GPL-3.0: modified redistributions must stay GPL. Requires Blender 5.3+. Light from Scan mode needs the separate Spirula Render engine.

procedure: Blender > Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions > Install from Disk, pick the zip
Import a splat (File > Import > PLY/SPZ), open 3D Viewport > N > Splat Patch

verdict.why: Release zip and GPL-3.0 LICENSE answer 200, README documents the tools with before/after images. Niche splat-cleanup tool with modest traction (9 stars), from the author of the Spirula splat tools.
